title: Extending the Agent's Reach
youtube_title: Extending the Agent's Reach: MCP, Tools and Skills | The Agentic Crew, Ch 9
description: An agent that can only see your repo is missing most of what it needs. This chapter shows how the Model Context Protocol connects agents to your logs, tickets and databases, how to design tools the model can actually use, and why read-only has to be enforced by the database itself rather than promised by a server.
